title: Reverse the playlist
hints: Fill `out` one slot at a time: `out[0]` gets the **last** song of `src`, `out[1]` the second-to-last, and so on.

Loop `i` from `0` while `i < count`. The last valid index of `src` is `count - 1`, so the element that belongs in `out[i]` is `i` steps back from there. Don't compute `count - 1` before the loop: with `count == 0` and an unsigned `size_t`, it wraps around to a huge number.
`for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) { out[i] = src[count - 1 - i]; }`
